package.description: Software for the upTEMP Multichannel USB Temperature Logger and upLED LED Driver.

en-US.description: Software for the upTEMP Multichannel USB Temperature Logger and upLED LED Driver.
en-US.longDescription: The upSERIES® software package is a graphical user interface for straightforward use of the upTEMP™ Multichannel USB Temperature Logger and the upLED™ LED Driver. For upTEMP™, the software allows the user to configure measurement parameters and displays data graphically for real-time temperature monitoring. For upLED™, the upSERIES software allows the forward current to be set and saved for later applications.
en-US.name: Thorlabs upSERIES

zh-CN.description: 适用于 upTEMP 多通道 USB 温度记录仪和 upLED LED 驱动器的软件。
zh-CN.longDescription: upSERIES® 软件包是为便捷操作 upTEMP™ 多通道 USB 温度记录仪和 upLED™ LED 驱动器设计的图形用户界面。针对 upTEMP™ 设备，该软件支持用户配置测量参数，并以图形化方式实时显示温度监测数据。对于 upLED™ 设备，upSERIES 软件可实现正向电流的设置及存储功能，便于后续应用调用。
